data.explanation: The International Office of your university congratulates you on your nomination for an Erasmus+ exchange semester at the University of Musterholm in winter 2026/27. To move forward, you must submit your signed Learning Agreement through the Mobility-Online portal by 15 May 2026. Without it, the university cannot forward your application to the host university. No payment is requested.
